name: m11-w3
note: I1, the OOLONG bridge: document mode, one fixed document per instance, flat prompt (A0-doc) versus the loop (A2-doc). Mechanism test only — it may not support a claim about retrieval, citations, the gate or the corpus (Evaluation.md §3.1, §6.1). Each instance supplies its own LENS_DOCUMENTS in its env, so this file cannot run until the converter writes both the instance file and the documents. The query list below is a one-instance placeholder; the real wave is 50 instances x 2 arms (expect 100) plus a 10-instance subset at n=3, and m11-waves.json carries the placeholder count until the instrument lands.

arms.name: a0-doc
arms.note: A0-doc: the whole document in one prompt, one call. No loop, no tools.

arms.name: a2-doc
arms.note: A2-doc: REPL over the same file. Sub-calls are 0 because the document prompt advertises no sub-task and sub_extract hydrates ids from the database, so the route would be a capability the run cannot use. The final gate and the claim pass are skipped in document mode and the skip is logged.

queries.text: Aggregate the records in the document and answer the question it poses. Answer with the exact label.
